ambiguity: true for length<=3/digits/common-word/proven prior collision; null if past-only24h intake symbol map capped/unreadable/any symbol missing; false only when complete map and no rule fired
author_accounts: distinct provider author_id; missing IDs count only in mentions and author_unknown_n
clock: source host receipt minus its stored finite clock_offset_s; compare with sheet_as_of; no implicit zero offset
coverage: new per-process epoch, connection intervals and committed heartbeat continuity; any pre-epoch window unknown; post-epoch known at >=90%; positive gap/unknown author/unknown ticker implies lower_bound
deletions: do not erase an already observed post
first_mention_age_s: integer floor of sheet_as_of minus earliest matched_at in retained tape
initialTweets: excluded from mentions/accounts; distinct matching backfill IDs in backfill_n
match: UNION: text version or mint link known by sheet_as_of; once per tweet_id; matched_at is first matching text receipt or causal mint-link receipt, never earlier unrelated text
match_basis: enabled channels: both when ticker known, else mint
p7_zero_proof: gap_s==0 and author_unknown_n==0 and scan_loss==false and accounts==0 and non-ambiguous; positive mint match can qualify despite ticker ambiguity per Am11
scan_loss: true when unlocatable pre-epoch matching versions can hide prior membership; row/read budget exhaustion is whole unknown:read_budget
top_author_followers: provider-reported followersCount; null if any matched author followers are missing
